text:
jordan: Heads up — ALB started deregistering targets for service/edge-ingress in us-west-2 around 07:12 UTC after we rolled the CNI canary to v2.4.0.
jordan: CloudWatch shows HTTP 502 for the ALB healthcheck path /_lb/health (interval 10s). Targets go Unhealthy -> Draining.
chris: Any recent changes to host networking? CNI canary yes, what did it change?
jordan: v2.4.0 enables transparent egress redirect (iptables REDIRECT -> 15001) and an EIP rewrite for NAT. I replicated a curl from node and saw different behaviour.
jordan: `curl -v -H "Host: edge.redwood.internal" http://127.0.0.1:8080/_lb/health` -> HTTP/1.1 502
maria: Can you paste kube events for the target pods? also svc type and target group type (ip/instance)?
jordan: target group is IP targets (nodes forward to pod hostPorts via kube-proxy), events show readiness probe passing in kubelet but ALB health failing. here's a tcpdump capture snippet:
```
07:11:55.123 IP 3.82.45.1.443 > 10.0.12.34.49152: Flags [P.], seq 1:512, ack 1, length 511
07:11:55.123 iptables DNAT: 10.0.12.34:49152 -> 127.0.0.1:15001
```
chris: That DNAT looks bad — ALB traffic hitting node gets redirected to the sidecar proxy on 15001 which expects upstream TLS or different HTTP host. ALB healthcheck sends Host header set to service domain; sidecar doesn't respond correctly -> 502.
sam: @jordan are we seeing same with control v1.4.9 nodes (no CNI canary)?
jordan: Control nodes (no canary) healthy. Canary nodes show DNAT rule present. iptables-save diff attached:
```
-A PREROUTING -m mark --mark 0x1 -j REDIRECT --to-ports 15001
```
maria: So the transparent-redirect rule didn't exclude traffic from nodePort/hostNetwork or ALB IP ranges. We should exclude traffic to the ALB health IPs or node-local health svc port.
chris: Quick mitigation: patch CNI config to add "excludeCIDRs" with ALB source ranges for the canary group, or delete PREROUTING rule on affected nodes.
sam: Rolling back the canary would stop further nodes adding the rule. What's impact to egress if we delete the rule? small — egress proxy will be bypassed.
jordan: I'm going to delete the iptables PREROUTING rule on the three canary nodes now.
jordan: done — removed rule on node-a,node-b,node-c. watch ALB.
ops-bot: metric: ALB healthy_count for tg-edge-ingress went 2 -> 10 over 60s
maria: Confirmed: targets re-registered. ALB health checks 200s.
chris: Follow-up: add exclusion for ALB source ranges and node-local ports in CNI config, and update rollout docs. Also add e2e test to ensure healthchecks bypass transparent redirect.
jordan: File created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345
deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered for cni v2.4.0 -> v2.3.8
sam: Nice catch — good runbook update. :thumbsup:
jordan: Closing — changed backlog to remediation. Thanks all.
